name: gizza-ai/video-to-dnxhd
summary: Transcode video to Avid DNxHR MOV or MXF for editing.

tool.description: Transcode a video into an Avid DNxHR editing intermediate in MOV or MXF. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). profile is dnxhr_lb|dnxhr_sq|dnxhr_hq|dnxhr_hqx|dnxhr_444 (default dnxhr_sq); container is mov|mxf (default mov); resolution optionally downscales without upscaling; pixel_format normally stays auto because DNxHR profiles dictate their pixel formats; audio is pcm16|pcm24|copy|none (default pcm16). Output is a large NLE-friendly intermediate, not a small web-delivery encode.

audio.description: Audio handling. pcm16 (default) writes uncompressed 16-bit PCM, pcm24 writes 24-bit PCM, copy stream-copies source audio when the wrapper accepts it, and none drops audio.

container.description: Wrapper for the DNxHR essence. mov (default) creates a QuickTime file that opens broadly; mxf creates an OP1a MXF interchange file for broadcast/Avid-style workflows.

pixel_format.description: Pixel format override. auto (default) chooses the only format allowed by the selected DNxHR profile; explicit values are accepted only when they match that profile.

profile.description: DNxHR quality tier. dnxhr_lb is smallest/offline, dnxhr_sq is the default standard-quality editorial intermediate, dnxhr_hq is higher-quality 8-bit 4:2:2, dnxhr_hqx is 10-bit 4:2:2 for grading, and dnxhr_444 is 10-bit 4:4:4 for VFX/keying.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

resolution.description: Optional downscale cap. source (default) preserves dimensions; 2160p, 1080p, and 720p cap the output height without upscaling smaller sources.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
